annotations.text:
WHAT CHANGED

1. The "Recently changed" strip — 10 audit cards, ~25% of the viewport — was on EVERY config screen. It is now one line at the bottom of the hub only.

2. Sprint IDs ("Owned by SA-4.9", "SA-4.2" under every nav item) are gone. Internal project management is not product copy.

3. The second vertical rail is gone. Sidebar + config nav ate 430px and left tables squeezed into a sliver. The section switcher is now a breadcrumb dropdown, so content gets the full width.

4. Five stacked Save buttons became one save bar that appears only when something is dirty.

5. The hub had no state — every section looked identical. Cards now carry status, and the two that need attention say so at the top.

6. Credits & limits opened with every price in a red error state. Only the row that is genuinely below cost is flagged now; red that is always on teaches people to ignore red.
